method: files: the family's vanilla texture folders and name rules; group: the theme of the file name and folder tokens (refselect::THEMES, subfamily::GROUPS), groups under 8 files count as other; measured: the vanilla-match sample of up to 400 files; style groups: deterministic k-medoids of the style descriptors, one group per 10 measured files, at most 8
